test: sub-test C — worn artefact WITH an inscription (SM_RV_18)
headline: THE CALLOUT REGIME RESCUES LEGIBILITY BUT NOT ACCURACY. Text renders crisply, confidently, in convincing personal pen-ink — and says the wrong thing.

character_level_diff.8.41: FAIL — candidate 1 reads 8.71 at 7x: the third glyph is a clear 7, a horizontal top stroke with a descending diagonal, not a 4. Candidate 2's third glyph is AMBIGUOUS between 4 and 7 at the resolution available, which is itself disqualifying: a mark that cannot be read with certainty cannot be certified. 8.41 is Tentoglou's actual Tokyo gold-winning distance, so 8.71 is a fabricated sporting claim about a living athlete, written as his own hand.
character_level_diff.TOKIO: SPLIT WITHIN A SINGLE PANEL — in the overhead callout of candidate 1 the RIGHT shoe reads TOKIO correctly, five characters, while the LEFT shoe reads TOKITO, six characters. The same panel disagrees with itself.
character_level_diff.Greek name: GARBLED in both candidates — the lambda-tau of Μίλτος collapses into a z-form and the surname trails into unreadable strokes. Note it appeared UNPROMPTED: my prompt named only 8.41 and TOKIO and said invent no other lettering. The REFERENCE supplied it. That is the inverse of the torch case, where the prompt supplied the string.

what_DID_hold: Form, material and structure held well: correct white spike silhouette, correct sole and spike plate, plausible wear, consistent shoe across all four figure views and all three callouts. Consistent with sub-test B — the reference carries the OBJECT.
consequence: Qualifies the sheet-first standing order rather than supporting it. Sheet-first is proven for FORM, MATERIAL and STRUCTURE (B: 5 of 6). It is REFUTED for TEXT. Inscriptions must still be cropped or withheld even inside a callout — and the callout makes the failure MORE dangerous, not less, because legible-and-wrong reads as authoritative where illegible-and-wrong reads as a limitation.
prediction_outcome: MY PREDICTION REFUTED. I pre-registered that the callout would hold legible and CORRECT marks while the worn views would not. The callout held legible marks that are WRONG. I had the regime right and the conclusion backwards.
